title: (test) Add regression tests for 401 Location-header redirect in openmrsFetch
body:

See existing PR titles for inspiration.

## If applicable

- [x] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests.

## Summary

Adds two regression tests covering the 401-redirect path in \`openmrsFetch\` (\`packages/framework/esm-api/src/openmrs-fetch.test.ts\`):

- When a 401 response contains a \`Location\` header (auth-module challenge), \`navigate\` is called with the \`Location\` URL
- When a 401 response has no \`Location\` header (genuine auth failure), \`navigate\` is called with the configured \`redirectAuthFailure.url\`
